authorization.allowed_scope: local/static/fixture source implementation and tests only
forbidden_operations: real event feed or live event listener
real lake / NAS / provider read or write
QMT / MiniQMT / xtquant runtime, simulation, paper, live, trading or broker operation
credential, .env, token, account or session read
event store, feature store, label store, prediction store, catalog pointer or model registry write
real order flow or real data validation

implementation_contract.summary: Implement S04 event-specific admission gate, shared status adapter and StrategyAdmissionPackage linkage.
required_semantics: Create engine/event_strategy_admission_gate.py as pure metadata evaluator; no IO, feed, runtime, broker, store, catalog or registry operations.
EventAdmissionGateStatus values are PASS, FAIL, NEEDS_REVIEW and BLOCKED; unknown statuses fail closed to BLOCKED.
evaluate_event_strategy_admission_gate requires PIT, method, test family, multiple-testing/data-snooping and trace evidence; missing mandatory evidence is BLOCKED.
Forbidden operation counters nonzero or non-integer are BLOCKED.
Status priority is BLOCKED > FAIL > NEEDS_REVIEW > PASS.
event_gate_summary must expose gate_present, gate_required, gate_status, gate_ref, blocked_reasons, needs_review_reasons, evidence_refs, operation_counts and no-runtime/no-feed/no-store limitations.
Modify engine/strategy_admission_package.py only to add event-specific reason code, map_event_gate_status_to_admission_status and attach_event_gate_to_admission_package.
attach_event_gate_to_admission_package must write event_gate_* fields and append event evidence refs without overwriting ML/statistical gate fields.
Event gate PASS must not clear not_qmt_authorization, not_simulation_authorization, not_live_authorization, not_broker_order, blocked_claims or runtime/trading limitations.
Do not redefine S01-S03 contracts in S04.

verification_commands: uv run --python 3.11 python -m py_compile engine/event_strategy_admission_gate.py engine/strategy_admission_package.py
